title: LoRa TDMA command (proposed contract)

created_at.description: Backend-issued UTC timestamp; semantic validation requires created_at < expires_at.

expires_at.description: Absolute UTC proposal/command acceptance deadline; MQTT Message Expiry is separate and also mandatory.

action.description: Proposed allowlist: C07 administrative actions apply at Gateway authorization enforcement; SET_PERIODIC_MODE OFF retains alert rights; REPROVISION requires a separate authenticated credential lifecycle (OPEN G2). SET_RELAY remains unapproved candidate.

params.description: Action-specific schema/authorization is pending cross-team review. Empty params permitted for SUSPEND_NODE/RESUME_NODE/REVOKE_NODE; SET_PERIODIC_MODE requires boolean enabled, other operations must validate explicitly. No automatic RF physical action from MQTT PUBACK.

description: DRAFT G0 C07/C08 control-plane. Gateway validates authenticated principal, Node scope, revocation version/expiry and durable enforcement. Authority to grant new credentials and exact RF command encoding remain OPEN G2.
